title: Add json_mode to LLMConfig and thread through complete() to provider call()
notes: Add json_mode: bool = False to LLMConfig. Add json_mode=False param to each provider call() signature. complete() reads config.json_mode and passes to provider. complete_with_retry() delegates through complete() so no change needed there. Unit tests: flag reaches provider layer when set; default path is unchanged; existing LLMConfig construction still works without json_mode arg.

title: OpenAI + OpenRouter providers: emit response_format json_object when json_mode
notes: OpenAIProvider.call(): when json_mode=True, add response_format={type: json_object} to create() kwargs; also ensure the literal word json appears somewhere in the system or user prompt (OpenAI API requirement). OpenRouterProvider.call(): same treatment in its own call() override. Unit tests: response_format present when on, absent when off; both providers tested independently.

title: Gemini provider: emit response_mime_type application/json when json_mode
notes: GeminiProvider.call(): when json_mode=True, add response_mime_type=application/json to GenerateContentConfig. Unit tests: field present in config when on, absent (not passed) when off.

title: Anthropic provider: assistant prefill when json_mode; document asymmetry
notes: AnthropicProvider.call(): when json_mode=True, append assistant prefill {role: assistant, content: {} to messages before calling messages.create. No response_format kwarg exists in Anthropic API. Add docstring comment documenting the asymmetry (prefill vs. API-native for other providers). Unit tests: no response_format in create() call; prefill message present when on; existing behavior unchanged when off.

title: structured_call gains json_mode param; propagates to config; ARCH update + back-compat sweep
notes: structured_call signature gains json_mode: bool = False. When json_mode=True: if config is a dataclass use dataclasses.replace(config, json_mode=True); if dict use {**config, json_mode: True}. Update ARCH_structured_llm.md Public API section and Change History. Confirm all existing callers in diplomat/phosphene/codexbot pass no json_mode arg (flag is default-off). Confirm existing structured_llm tests still pass unmodified.

title: Baseline test: lock current parse_json_response behavior against all four R1 fixtures
notes: Fixtures already committed. Write test asserting r1_reasoned/r1_raw/r1_extract parse successfully; r1_fenced raises ValueError. This locks the gap before the fix lands.

title: Implement outermost-balanced-{...} extraction fallback in parse_json_response
notes: After existing fence-strip path, add a fallback that extracts the outermost balanced {...} object from surrounding prose. Must use balanced-brace matching (not naive first-{). Include: test over all four fixtures (all parse); test proving it picks the intended object over a {...}-fragment embedded in prose; no change to clean-JSON or whole-fence-response paths.

title: Unit test: OpenRouter reasoning separation (reasoning in message.reasoning, no <think> in content)
notes: No code change expected. Add a test in tests/structured_llm/ that reads the r1_fenced.meta.json fixture metadata and asserts has_reasoning_field=true, content_has_think_tag=false. Also verify the existing llm_client OpenRouter provider path handles message.reasoning (read providers.py, write a unit test or note in the test). Documents the existing separation so the no-<think>-stripping decision is grounded in real behavior.

title: Docs + back-compat sweep
notes: Update ARCH_structured_llm.md: (1) revise Out of Scope from no-prose-extraction to bounded-extraction note (fence strip + outermost balanced object; no general repair; no <think> until real inline-reasoning fixture exists); (2) update parse_json_response doc to describe the fallback; (3) append Change History row. Confirm all pre-existing parse_json_response tests still pass (additive change only).
